title: Exit sign
summary: Approve with notes: confirm the items below.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Rated life (L70)
findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
findings.why_it_matters: Ensures the sign will maintain adequate brightness over time for reliable egress marking.

findings.title: Warranty
findings.detail: Package states 5 years; spec requires at least 5 yr.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: macadam steps
findings.detail: LEDs shall be binned within a maximum 3-step MacAdam Ellipse.
findings.why_it_matters: Guarantees consistent light color across fixtures, avoiding noticeable variations that could affect appearance or compliance.

findings.title: Check which document version is current
findings.detail: Submitted Rev. 09/05/19, web source Rev. 08/07/24. The revision labels differ; their age order is not confirmed.
findings.why_it_matters: Using outdated or incorrect documents risks installing non-compliant materials, even if current submittal seems acceptable.

Lithonia LQM discontinued or end of life or replacement

args.evidence_quote: Lithonia Lighting® LQM Quantum® LED Exit Signs are suitable for identifying emergency exits. This fully assembled single-face exit with extra faceplate is available in red or green letters. Ideal for applications requiring attractive, quick-installation exit signs and low energy consumption. The emergency power provides 90 minutes of illumination in the event of a power loss.
args.note: Found manufacturer's document for Lithonia LQM Quantum® LED Exit Signs showing specifications including dual-voltage 120/277V input, power consumption ranging from 0.62W-0.92W, service temperature range of 50° to 104°F (10°C to 40°C), compliance with UL924, NFPA 101, NEC, OSHA standards, and 5-year limited warranty. No discontinuation notices found; recent product updates (Nov 2025) suggest active product line.
